div.h1: Veterinary clinic Karlovy Vary — Elite Vet

div.div: We look forward to seeing you!
Your pets in the best hands!

div.p: Outside of office hours, the emergency fee includes the working time of the doctor and nurse based on their actual involvement in care. The mentioned surcharges are charged in addition to the cost of examinations, procedures, medications, and materials used.
These supplements allow us to ensure and appropriately reward the professional team during weekend and emergency care for your animals.

div.h2: We have built a modern clinic for your pets
div.p: We have built a modern veterinary clinic in Karlovy Vary for you — a long-term project with the goal of offering comprehensive veterinary care in the region, all in one place.
The clinic is equipped with modern diagnostic and treatment technology and from the outset offers extended opening hours including weekends. We will gradually extend our operation further.

img.alt: Reception of the Elite Vet veterinary clinic in Karlovy Vary

div.h3: We are here for you every day
div.p: We are in full operation — mon – fri 8:00 – 20:00, sat – sun 10:00 – 18:00. Book online or by phone at the reception.
Swipe sideways to browse the photos
Dogs, cats and small mammals — comprehensive veterinary care in one place, with technology at a very high level. Our goal is to provide the widest possible range of care under one roof.
Regular check-ups, vaccinations and deworming. Prevention is the foundation of your pet's health.
Neutering and abdominal procedures. A modern operating theatre with anaesthesia monitoring.
Diagnosis and treatment of internal diseases, cardiology, endocrinology and gastroenterology.
RTG, ultrasound, laboratory blood and urine tests. Fast and accurate diagnostics for proper treatment.​
Dental treatment, extractions, ultrasonic cleaning. Oral care for your pet's healthy teeth.
Examination and treatment of eye diseases in small animals, including diagnostics and surgical procedures.
Treatment of skin problems, allergies and parasitic diseases. Comprehensive care for skin and coat.
We have doctors specialising in ultrasound diagnostics. We are developing this area further, including towards cardiology examinations.
